_comment: Reference values for qe-error-diagnose (QE 7.4 conda-forge build hac89879_0, PBE). case1: Si diamond celldm(1)=10.26, ecutwfc=45/ecutrho=360, 4x4x4 shifted grid, conv_thr 1e-10. case2: same cell, ecutwfc=35/ecutrho=280. case3: CO in a 20-bohr cubic box (bond 1.20 Ang), ecutwfc=50/ecutrho=400, gamma, smearing mv 0.01, conv_thr 1e-9. Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: 5 oracle runs produced identical energies at the 1e-8 Ry print resolution (spread 0). Each case runs in ~5-15 s (case3 SCF converges in 10 iterations at mixing_beta=0.5; the broken input needs 37 at mixing_beta=0.05, so electron_maxstep=20 fails with a >1.8x margin). Case settings deliberately avoid every cutoff published elsewhere in the repo: case1's -22.83956417 sits 4.1e-5 Ry from the published ecut=50 value and 5.4e-5 from qe-scf-si's; case2's -22.83946403 sits 4.9e-5 from the published ecut=40 value; case3's -59.99734591 sits 1.3e-2 from qe-relax-co's published energy — all outside the 1e-5 tolerance, so reusing any published number fails.
